visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) This is a real-life video. The scene opens outside an izakaya at night. A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a black baseball cap and a black one-shoulder crop top, stands on a sidewalk. A hand enters the frame from the bottom left, reaching toward her. The background shows a wooden storefront with Japanese characters, glowing lanterns, and passersby in the distance. The lighting is warm and artificial from the shop. (2) The camera moves dynamically as the hand grabs the woman's pink bag. She looks surprised, her eyes wide and mouth slightly open. The environment shifts rapidly as she is pulled toward the camera. There are motion blur effects and quick cuts. A menu appears briefly in front of her face as a graphic overlay. The camera transitions from the outdoor street to the indoor restaurant setting through a series of fast-paced movements. (3) The scene settles inside the dimly lit izakaya. The woman sits at a wooden table, still holding her bag. A person's hand feeds her a grilled meat skewer using chopsticks. She eats with a satisfied expression, closing her eyes briefly. In the background, a television screen displays a sports program, and the walls are decorated with Japanese posters and menus. The lighting is warm and atmospheric, highlighting the textures of the wooden furniture and the food. (4) A close-up shot focuses on a charcoal grill. Several skewers of meat are being grilled over bright orange flames and glowing coals. A chef's gloved hand uses metal tongs to flip the meat. Plumes of smoke rise from the grill. To the side, various Japanese banners and posters hang from the ceiling, creating a cluttered but cozy tavern atmosphere. (5) A montage of various dishes is presented. First, a grilled fish is seasoned with lime and salt. Then, plates of grilled beef tongue with green onions and seafood udon with white sauce are shown. The woman is seen tasting these dishes, expressing enjoyment through smiles and nodding. Text overlays appear at the bottom of the screen describing each dish. The lighting remains warm, focusing on the vibrant colors and glistening textures of the food. (6) The final phase shows the woman eating a dessert skewer, with heart-shaped graphics appearing over her eyes. The camera then cuts to a static black screen with white and red text. This screen displays the restaurant's name, address in Tucheng District, and a phone number. The lighting transitions from the warm restaurant interior to a flat, high-contrast digital display.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy, upbeat English pop song featuring a female vocalist. The tempo is approximately 120 BPM with a strong, four-on-the-floor electronic kick drum. The vocals are clear and bright. No ambient street noise is audible, suggesting a studio-produced track. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect marks the transition as the visual character is pulled. The music continues with percussive elements added. The vocalist sings the hook 'You're my soda pop.' The dynamic range is narrow, indicating heavy compression typical of social media content. (3) A percussive 'click' and 'pop' SFX occurs as the woman starts eating inside. The music shifts to a rhythmic beat that aligns with the quick editing cuts of the food montage. The bass frequencies are emphasized. (4) A sizzling sound effect is introduced as the visuals show the charcoal grill. This sound is crisp and high-frequency, layered over the existing BGM. The music's volume dips slightly to allow the sizzling sound to be prominent, then swells back up. (5) The music enters a rhythmic loop with a consistent, driving beat. Each new dish shown is accompanied by a subtle 'ding' or 'sparkle' SFX, highlighting the visual appearance of text overlays. The vocal delivery in the BGM remains energetic. (6) As the final dessert is shown, a 'cartoon spring' SFX plays, matching the heart-eye graphics. The music then begins a quick fade-out. The final black screen is accompanied by the tail end of the music's reverb and a final soft percussive hit.
